description: Defines the MimeSupportabilityCache class for caching MIME type supportability information, including support for bitrate ranges, with singleton access, cache management, and supportability querying functions.

classes.name: MimeSupportabilityCache
classes.description: Singleton class managing cache of MIME supportability info, including support for bitrate ranges, with thread safety and cache control methods.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MimeSupportabilityCache.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the cache is enabled.

methods.name: SetCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the cache.

methods.name: GetMimeSupportability
methods.description: Retrieves supportability info for a MIME string, parsing and caching if necessary.

methods.name: CacheMimeSupportability
methods.description: Caches supportability info for a MIME string.

methods.name: ClearCachedMimeSupportabilities
methods.description: Clears cached supportability info without removing parsed MIME info.
